_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'We discover, develop, manufacture, and market products in a single business segment—human pharmaceutical products.' (FY2021 10-K, Item 1); 'We depend on products with intellectual property protection for most of our revenues, cash flows, and earnings; we have lost or soon will lose effective intellectual property protection for a number of our products, which has resulted and is likely to continue to result in rapid and severe declines in revenues.' (FY2021 10-K, Item 1A heading); 'Our long-term success depends on intellectual property protection; if our intellectual property rights are invalidated, circumvented, or weakened, our business will be adversely affected.' (FY2021 10-K, Item 1A heading); 'We and our products face intense competition from multinational pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, and lower-cost generic and biosimilar manufacturers, and such competition could have a material adverse effect on our business.' (FY2021 10-K, Item 1A heading); 'For non-biologic products, loss of exclusivity (whether by expiration of legal rights or by termination thereof as a consequence of litigation) typically results in the entry of one or more generic competitors, leading to a rapid and severe decline in revenues' (FY2021 10-K, Item 1A); 'Our product revenues can be adversely affected by the introduction by competitors of branded products that are perceived as superior by the marketplace, by generic or biosimilar versions of our branded products, and by generic or biosimilar versions of other products in the same therapeutic class as our branded products.' (FY2021 10-K, Item 1A)

BEAR.desc: EPS -53.5%/yr (worst year FY12-FY21 ex-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +4.9%/yr (FY22 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY17 median

BULL.desc: EPS +5.9%/yr (FY12-FY21 ex-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +49.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY21 ex-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LLY (retrospective, 2022-06-10) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (93.3% downside to Bear $20 / +-8.1% upside to Bull $273) | Adj composite 2.45 vs market 3.22: gap -0.77 [OVERVALUED] | +68% above the EPP floor $177 (24x FY22E $7.38) | Conservative 2-yr case: -23.7% total (-11.8%/yr) | At 40.3x FY22E the 15% hurdle price $393 sits above the BULL case; U.S. revenues +31.0% in Q1 2022, forward revenues +1.7-3.5% (FY22 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
